card.name: Start of book ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: The leading 0 or the hyphen right after it at the start of an ISBN in a book citation, or the 0 after the 978- prefix. It is mostly seen in English-language publisher references.

modes.label: Leading 0 after ISBN
modes.description: The digit 0 that begins an ISBN directly after the word ISBN.

modes.label: Hyphen after the 0
modes.description: The hyphen following an initial 0 in an ISBN.
modes.example: Library Palang-faack Edition, New York. ISBN 0<<->>375-7613

modes.label: 0 after 978-
modes.description: The 0 following the 978- prefix of a 13-digit ISBN.

card.plain: It fires at the very start of a book's ISBN number in a reference list, on the opening 0 or the hyphen after it.
